integrity: Direct enumeration and exact symbolic computations independently compared with proof; all-size conclusions are analytic and not deduced from finite tests. No external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts weak one-site energy minima on labelled periodic nearest-neighbour spin-1 chains with positive uniform crystal field and no external field. Neutral moves are permitted in the stability test; no absorbing-state, kinetic time-scale, fixed-magnetization, or finite-temperature assertion is made. Earlier long-range Blume–Capel article not accessible in full; equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
title: An isolated weak-blocking entropy maximum in the spin-1 Blume–Capel ring
